value.title: Paired-output curvature and sharpened two-letter covariance pruning
value.statement: For every input law on the governed half-skew BSSC product channel P^{otimes 2}, define c_in=Pr[X_1X_2=11]-Pr[X_1=1]Pr[X_2=1] and C_out=I(Y_1;Y_2)+I(Z_1;Z_2). Then, including boundary cases, C_out >= 31 c_in^2/(20 ln 2). For any finite two-letter Marton law whose unnormalized value exceeds twice the optimal one-letter randomized-time-division value, result-two-letter-marton-marginal-correlation-pruning supplies C_out<7/160; consequently every such law satisfies |c_in|<sqrt(7 ln 2/248)<7/50. The latter conclusion is only a necessary condition and neither constructs nor excludes a Marton gain, tensorizes Marton's functional, nor gives a capacity converse.
scopeQualifications: The gain implication applies only to finite two-letter Marton laws on the governed half-skew BSSC product channel whose unnormalized value exceeds twice the optimal one-letter randomized-time-division value.
The dependency is required only for the implication C_out<7/160; the unconditional curvature inequality is established within this result for every input law, including boundary cases.
The sharpened covariance bound is solely a necessary condition; it neither constructs nor rules out a gain, tensorizes Marton's functional, nor proves a capacity converse.

proofs: Memorylessness and the affine half-skew BSSC output laws give Cov(Y_1,Y_2)=Cov(Z_1,Z_2)=c_in/4.

Along the fixed-output-marginal covariance segment, differentiating the two binary-table divergences and grouping the eight reciprocal cell terms yields a uniform paired curvature strictly exceeding 248/(5 ln 2).

Twice integrating the paired curvature from the independent tables, where the divergence and its first derivative vanish, gives C_out >= 31 c_in^2/(20 ln 2); continuity covers zero-cell and degenerate boundary cases.
Combining the unconditional curvature inequality with the dependency's strict bound C_out<7/160 gives c_in^2<7 ln 2/248, and a directed logarithmic comparison proves sqrt(7 ln 2/248)<7/50.
methods: Affine output-covariance identities for the half-skew BSSC
Binary-table KL curvature along fixed-marginal covariance segments
Exact polynomial positivity and boundary continuity
computations: The submitted standard-library checker verifies the reciprocal-class polynomial identities and positivity bracket, the curvature rescaling from 248/5 to 31/20, the exact dependency metadata, and directed comparisons establishing 7 ln 2/248<(7/50)^2.
tools: The submitted Python standard-library verifier performs exact rational checks and outward-directed Decimal comparisons without network access or external packages.

value.title: Multiletter Marton support search
value.objective: Determine whether multiletter Marton coding can strictly improve the current half-skew BSSC achievable rate, and rigorously characterize the super-input support and auxiliary structure required by any such improvement.
value.currentStateSummary: The finite-auxiliary multiletter Marton sequence is unconditionally bounded and superadditive, has a Fekete normalized limit, and scales exactly under independent repetition of a selected law; the exact randomized-time-division threshold is certified, while the associated capacity and one-letter-optimum interpretations retain their stated hypotheses. Conditional-product laws are additive on finite receiver-skew channels, and every arbitrary finite two-letter gaining law must pass four constant-padding correlation tests. A law exceeding twice the optimal one-letter randomized-time-division value must have full super-input support with the certified symbol-mass floors, input marginals q_1,q_2 in (3/8,5/8), marginal sum in (17/20,23/20), and C_out=I(Y_1;Y_2)+I(Z_1;Z_2)<7/160; the reflected/transposed family additionally requires 1/8<alpha<5/13. A paired binary-output-table curvature theorem now gives the unconditional inequality C_out>=31c_in^2/(20 ln 2) for every product-channel input law, including boundary cases, and sharpens the necessary covariance condition for a finite two-letter gain to |c_in|<sqrt(7 ln 2/248)<7/50. All these gain filters are necessary only and neither establish nor exclude a gain. Whether a full-support, genuinely conditionally coupled finite law satisfying every filter can gain remains open.
value.localResidualSummary: Restrict the two-letter search to genuinely nonfactorizable full-support finite Marton laws satisfying the certified symbol-mass floors, all four padding-correlation tests, q_1,q_2 in (3/8,5/8), 17/20<q_1+q_2<23/20, C_out<7/160, and the sharpened covariance condition |c_in|<sqrt(7 ln 2/248)<7/50; retain the crossed padding tests separately. Within the reflected/transposed family, also impose 1/8<alpha<5/13. Seek stronger interior pruning or a certified law above 2L_RTD. Independently authenticate or prove the stated Marton-achievability and binary-input hypotheses, investigate finite-auxiliary cardinality control and extensions beyond finite auxiliaries, and keep superadditivity distinct from additivity and fixed-blocklength optimization distinct from a capacity converse.

value.title: Canonical problem
value.currentStateSummary: Four complementary directions are established. Genuine deterministic finite-block private-message codes induce approximate dependence balance, a fixed encoder-coordinate map, and four compatible rate rows, while an explicit nonbinary witness obstructs the specified coarse entropy and finite copy-lemma route; fixed-cardinality auxiliaries and exact BSSC posterior consistency remain unresolved. The separately relaxed UV scalars tensorize, with receiver-skew symmetry giving equality of the branchwise and averaged scalars and half-skew BSSC product values n(2h_2(1/4)-5/4), but these scalars do not establish capacity. Conditional on the exact encoded Gohari–Liu–Nair Theorem 9 premise, the private-message specialization yields C_sum<=inf_{G,K}B(G,K); compact receiver-curve approximation, finite-grid reduction, row-stability bounds, exact Q0 coercivity, and one fixed-pair weak-duality certificate conditionally giving C_sum<=0.369296945969202842443 are available, while premise authentication, unrelaxed convergence, receiver optimality, and matching achievability remain open. In the Marton direction, finite-auxiliary quantities are bounded and superadditive and have a certified randomized-time-division threshold. Conditional-product architectures are additive, arbitrary two-letter candidates must pass four padding-correlation tests, and any candidate exceeding twice the optimal one-letter randomized-time-division value must have full support with certified mass floors, q_1,q_2 in (3/8,5/8), 17/20<q_1+q_2<23/20, and C_out<7/160. The new unconditional paired-output curvature bound C_out>=31c_in^2/(20 ln 2) sharpens the resulting necessary input-covariance condition to |c_in|<sqrt(7 ln 2/248)<7/50; the reflected/transposed family also requires 1/8<alpha<5/13. These conditions neither construct nor exclude a Marton gain, tensorize Marton's functional, or provide a capacity converse. Full-support, conditionally coupled laws satisfying all constraints remain unresolved.
value.localResidualSummary: Authenticate or independently prove the external converse and achievability premises. Convert compact receiver-curve approximation and relaxed-row stability into an unrelaxed converse limit, strengthen receiver coercivity, and assess optimality of the certified fixed pair. Derive exact binary-BSSC posterior and multiletter constraints for genuine code-induced laws while retaining coupling absent from the additive relaxed UV scalars. In the achievability direction, search only among genuinely nonfactorizable full-support two-letter Marton laws satisfying the symbol-mass floors, four padding tests, marginal-balance windows, C_out<7/160, and |c_in|<sqrt(7 ln 2/248)<7/50, with the additional alpha-window on the reflected/transposed family; compare candidates rigorously against 2L_RTD. Clarify finite-auxiliary cardinality scope and never infer a capacity converse from a fixed blocklength. Exact capacity still requires closing the converse gap and supplying a matching achievable rate.

placementAudit.rationale: The accepted claim supplies an independently reusable unconditional product-channel curvature inequality and a sharper necessary covariance filter for the existing two-letter Marton search. It therefore belongs in the established multiletter Marton support-search program and depends only on the existing marginal-correlation pruning result for the gain-specific bound C_out<7/160. The result changes that local portfolio and the root synthesis, but requires no new program, move, split, merge, or retirement.
